learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the rich and colorful heritage of ancient Indian storytelling, from beautiful scroll paintings to lively puppet shows!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Long ago, storytellers would travel from village to village carrying long painted canvas scrolls. They would unroll these colorful paintings section by section while singing epic tales of heroes and gods.

Puppets are small figures controlled by strings, sticks, or shadows. In India, puppetry is a famous traditional art where wooden or leather figures dance on a tiny stage to tell funny and exciting folk tales.

Before books were common, history and stories were kept alive orally. Storytellers used voice modulation, singing, and exciting sound effects to keep everyone listening eagerly around the village fire.

fun_activity.title: ✂️ Make a Stick Puppet
fun_activity.instructions: Draw your favorite animal or hero on thick paper, color it brightly, cut it out, and tape it to a wooden stick or pencil. Hide behind a table and use your puppet to tell a short fun story to your family!

quick_recap: ⭐ India has an incredible history of sharing stories through scroll paintings and puppetry.
⭐ These traditional arts combine visual art, music, and acting to bring ancient legends to life.
